info.title: NYCU EE Activity CMS contract
info.description: A/G contract. Public activity GET endpoints and existing password authentication are implemented. Account management, Google OIDC, editing/publishing and media routes remain planned. Permission checks must be server-side and per resource. See activity-cms-contract.md and cms-platform-contract.md.

BadRequest.description: Invalid fields or state; fieldErrors identify content paths.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired or disabled session; invalid login credentials.

Forbidden.description: Role, resource scope, CSRF or provider-state verification denied.

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist or is not publicly available.

Conflict.description: Stale version, identity conflict, referenced resource or last-admin protection.
